contentList.content: Targets have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against any ability that uses your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_MANEUVER_SAVE_DC">Maneuver DC</LSTag>, including manoeuvres, weapon actions, and artifact effects.
Dealing damage with this weapon forces the target to become Tortured for [1] turn(s), unless it succeeds a Charisma Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC.
Dealing Cold damage with a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_INFO_SPELL">spell</LSTag> inflicts <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag> upon the target.
When the wearer deals Fire damage, the target begins <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burning</LSTag> if it is not already on fire.

Chance to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stun</LSTag> the wielder, unless it is a construct or succeeds a Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> against your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_MANEUVER_SAVE_DC">Maneuver DC</LSTag>.

When a creature misses you with an attack, it must succeed a Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> against your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_MANEUVER_SAVE_DC">Maneuver DC</LSTag> or be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag> for [1] turns.
Taking damage from this weapon, the target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC or begin Bleeding for [1] turns.
Offensive spells deal additional damage equal to this effect's remaining duration.
